initial.reply:

initial.reply:
查询和办理的区别主要在于“是否改变状态”：

- **查询**：只读取信息，不改变任何订单或资金状态。例如查订单列表、订单详情、物流进度、支付状态、退款资格，或检索平台政策。查询可以随时进行，通常不需要额外确认。
- **办理**：会发起或推进一项操作，可能改变状态。例如准备支付、申请退款、创建工单。资金类操作会先“准备”，再由你在界面上确认，不会自动扣款或退款；准备不等于已经完成。

简单说：查询是“看一看”，办理是“动一动”。你这次只是让我解释区别，我不会查询订单，也不会办理任何业务。

- 连接方式：蓝牙5.3，另有3.5毫米有线输入[60114abb-6421-53c3-83d5-67c3969921cd][d600bccc-decb-5811-ba4d-8a791267b7a3]。

包装内含耳机、充电线和音频线，首次使用可按说明完成连接或装配，避免强行插拔接口[60114abb-6421-53c3-83d5-67c3969921cd]。

# POL-101 支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“无理由退货”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

### 综合说明

结论：平台无理由退货期限为签收后7天内；定制商品属于例外，通常不适用无理由退货。

具体来说：
- 无理由退货期限：自签收之日起7天内可申请无理由退货，商品需保持完好、不影响二次销售。
- 定制商品例外：按客户要求定制或个性化加工的商品，一般不适用无理由退货；如存在质量问题，仍可按质量问题流程处理。

以上为平台规则说明，具体订单能否退货还需结合商品状态和订单情况判断。

### 综合说明

可以给你一个政策分类概览，但需要先说明：下面每类只列一条示例规则，不是该类全部规则，也没有覆盖每条规则的全部细节。完整规则仍需在平台资料详情页按分类查看。

- 账户与身份：注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱；同一联系方式仅绑定一个主账户[0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5]。
- 下单与库存：加入购物车不锁定库存，以提交订单时的可售数量为准[2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c]。
- 价格与促销：结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准，历史截图不能单独证明成交价[0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4]。
- 优惠券：每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券[03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a]。
- 支付与安全：支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准[73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff]。
- 配送范围：配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准[2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a]。
- 发货与时效：现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计[e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c]。
- 地址与改派：付款前可在结算页修改收货地址[5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d]。
- 签收与验货：签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压[0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c]。
- 取消订单：待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消[99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305]。
- 无理由退货：支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请[ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb]。
- 质量售后：功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求[eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478]。
- 退货物流：通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回[6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a]。
- 退款进度：退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核[53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a]。
- 换货与维修：换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况[4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d]。
- 发票与凭证：发票抬头应在申请时准确填写[acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2]。
- 隐私与资料：只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息[d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5]。
- 商品描述与兼容：商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致[8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb]。
- 评价与内容：评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私[d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329]。
- 客服与争议：查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录[4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303]。

所以，这份概览覆盖了政策分类，但每类仅一条示例，不能视为每条规则全部细节的完整说明。

tasks.source_text: 并说明是否覆盖每条规则全部细节
tasks.answer:
可以给你一个政策分类概览，但需要先说明：下面每类只列一条示例规则，不是该类全部规则，也没有覆盖每条规则的全部细节。完整规则仍需在平台资料详情页按分类查看。

- 账户与身份：注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱；同一联系方式仅绑定一个主账户[0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5]。
- 下单与库存：加入购物车不锁定库存，以提交订单时的可售数量为准[2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c]。
- 价格与促销：结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准，历史截图不能单独证明成交价[0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4]。
- 优惠券：每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券[03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a]。
- 支付与安全：支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准[73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff]。
- 配送范围：配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准[2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a]。
- 发货与时效：现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计[e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c]。
- 地址与改派：付款前可在结算页修改收货地址[5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d]。
- 签收与验货：签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压[0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c]。
- 取消订单：待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消[99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305]。
- 无理由退货：支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请[ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb]。
- 质量售后：功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求[eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478]。
- 退货物流：通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回[6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a]。
- 退款进度：退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核[53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a]。
- 换货与维修：换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况[4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d]。
- 发票与凭证：发票抬头应在申请时准确填写[acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2]。
- 隐私与资料：只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息[d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5]。
- 商品描述与兼容：商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致[8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb]。
- 评价与内容：评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私[d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329]。
- 客服与争议：查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录[4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303]。

所以，这份概览覆盖了政策分类，但每类仅一条示例，不能视为每条规则全部细节的完整说明。

sources.title: 账户与身份：注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱
sources.content:
## 具体规定
注册使用可接收验证码的手机号或邮箱；同一联系方式仅绑定一个主账户。

sources.title: 下单与库存：加入购物车不锁定库存
sources.content:
## 具体规定
加入购物车不锁定库存；以提交订单时的可售数量为准。

sources.title: 价格与促销：结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
结算价格以提交订单的商品明细为准；历史截图不能单独证明成交价。

sources.title: 优惠券：每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券
sources.content:
## 具体规定
每笔订单最多使用一张平台优惠券。

sources.title: 支付与安全：支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
支持的付款渠道以结算页面选项为准。

sources.title: 配送范围：配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准
sources.content:
## 具体规定
配送范围须以收货地区校验结果为准。

sources.title: 发货与时效：现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计
sources.content:
## 具体规定
现货订单一般在付款后两个工作日内安排出库，节假日另计。

sources.title: 地址与改派：付款前可在结算页修改收货地址
sources.content:
## 具体规定
付款前可在结算页修改收货地址。

sources.title: 签收与验货：签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压
sources.content:
## 具体规定
签收前检查外包装是否破损、浸水或明显挤压。

sources.title: 取消订单：待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消
sources.content:
## 具体规定
待付款订单可在平台订单页申请取消。

sources.title: 无理由退货：支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请
sources.content:
## 具体规定
支持无理由退货的商品须在签收后七日内提出申请。

sources.title: 质量售后：功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求
sources.content:
## 具体规定
功能故障应先排查使用环境与说明书要求。

sources.title: 退货物流：通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回
sources.content:
## 具体规定
通过售后单确认退货地址后再寄回。

sources.title: 退款进度：退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核
sources.content:
## 具体规定
退款申请提交后先进行资格和材料审核。

sources.title: 换货与维修：换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况
sources.content:
## 具体规定
换货需先核实库存与原商品故障情况。

sources.title: 发票与凭证：发票抬头应在申请时准确填写
sources.content:
## 具体规定
发票抬头应在申请时准确填写。

sources.title: 隐私与资料：只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息
sources.content:
## 具体规定
只收集完成订单及售后所需的必要信息。

sources.title: 商品描述与兼容：商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致
sources.content:
## 具体规定
商品编号用于区分不同型号，外观相似不代表规格一致。

sources.title: 评价与内容：评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私
sources.content:
## 具体规定
评价应基于实际交易体验，不得发布他人隐私。

sources.title: 客服与争议：查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录
sources.content:
## 具体规定
查询订单应提供订单号，系统仅返回本人可访问记录。

tasks.source_text: 说明申请已记录与实际到账的区别
tasks.answer:
订单 1001：退款状态为“申请已记录”（requested），已有退款申请正在处理中，当前可退金额为 0.00。订单 1006：退款状态为“无申请”（none），符合退款条件，可退金额为 59.99，但尚未提交退款申请。

“申请已记录”与“实际到账”的区别：申请已记录只表示退款申请已被系统登记，不代表退款已审核通过，也不代表资金已退回[来源ID:6fc13eca-dcc8-5525-8aeb-8292ce899465]。退款申请提交后，会先进行资格和材料审核[来源ID:e466dd49-99fa-5c54-81f1-1383398cbcb9]；审核通过与实际资金到账属于不同阶段[来源ID:328766db-b404-5200-8d4e-5e2c47c4eec3]。到账时间取决于支付渠道，无法统一承诺固定天数[来源ID:99019f5f-703d-533a-886c-5a5d6a557d3c]。查看退款进度应以真实回执和状态记录为准[来源ID:3a10cae9-8aef-5849-ace1-ba1c28e398ef]。

# POL-139 查看退款进度必须使用真实回执和状态记录

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“退款进度”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
查看退款进度必须使用真实回执和状态记录。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

### 综合说明

订单 1001：退款状态为“申请已记录”（requested），已有退款申请正在处理中，当前可退金额为 0.00。订单 1006：退款状态为“无申请”（none），符合退款条件，可退金额为 59.99，但尚未提交退款申请。

“申请已记录”与“实际到账”的区别：申请已记录只表示退款申请已被系统登记，不代表退款已审核通过，也不代表资金已退回[来源ID:6fc13eca-dcc8-5525-8aeb-8292ce899465]。退款申请提交后，会先进行资格和材料审核[来源ID:e466dd49-99fa-5c54-81f1-1383398cbcb9]；审核通过与实际资金到账属于不同阶段[来源ID:328766db-b404-5200-8d4e-5e2c47c4eec3]。到账时间取决于支付渠道，无法统一承诺固定天数[来源ID:99019f5f-703d-533a-886c-5a5d6a557d3c]。查看退款进度应以真实回执和状态记录为准[来源ID:3a10cae9-8aef-5849-ace1-ba1c28e398ef]。

本条属于“退款进度”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
审核通过与实际资金到账是不同阶段。

涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

turns.message: Hello. Please explain how order queries differ from financial actions. Answer in English this turn.

initial.reply:
Hi! In short: order queries are read-only lookups, while financial actions change money or payment state.

- Order queries (e.g., order list, details, status, shipment, payment status) just retrieve information about your orders. They don't change anything.
- Financial actions (e.g., preparing a payment or a refund) are state-changing steps. They require your clear intent, are handled one at a time in order, and typically need a separate final confirmation before anything is executed.

So checking is safe and repeatable; paying or refunding is deliberate and confirmed. Let me know if you'd like to look up an order or start a payment/refund.

tasks.source_text: How many days after delivery can I request a no-reason return? Are customized products excluded?
tasks.answer:
You can request a no-reason return within seven days after delivery [6c35037b-2cb5-5d64-b578-207e63f60959]. Yes, customized products are excluded: they don't qualify for ordinary no-reason returns, and quality issues are handled separately [3a796bae-9510-55cb-b305-4946b75837c9].

tasks.source_text: How many days after delivery can I request a no-reason return? Are customized products excluded?
tasks.answer:

turns.message: Give me an overview of all platform policies.

initial.reply:
### 综合说明

Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the documentation:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove a transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the validation result for the delivery region [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address via the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product descriptions & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specs [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

This is a category overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available in the platform documentation by category.

tasks.source_text: Give me an overview of all platform policies.
tasks.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the documentation:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove a transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the validation result for the delivery region [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address via the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product descriptions & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specs [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

This is a category overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available in the platform documentation by category.

- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].

- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].

- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].

- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

final.reply:
### 综合说明

Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the documentation:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove a transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the validation result for the delivery region [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address via the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product descriptions & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specs [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

This is a category overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available in the platform documentation by category.

result.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the documentation:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove a transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the validation result for the delivery region [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address via the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product descriptions & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specs [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

This is a category overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available in the platform documentation by category.

result.answer:
Here's an overview of the platform policy topics covered in the documentation:

- **Account & identity (POL-001):** Register with a phone number or email that can receive verification codes; one contact method binds to only one main account [0ba56268-af05-5a1b-ba92-f775cc0db8b5].
- **Ordering & stock (POL-011):** Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is based on the quantity sellable when the order is submitted [2a38e68b-5e00-5bc4-a17d-4d79b8f43f0c].
- **Pricing & promotions (POL-021):** The checkout price follows the item details at order submission; historical screenshots alone cannot prove a transaction price [0ee79284-ba5c-561c-af58-814f27fbb2c4].
- **Coupons (POL-031):** At most one platform coupon per order [03611fbf-9c67-51b2-afd9-5d8964012e0a].
- **Payment & security (POL-041):** Supported payment channels are those shown on the checkout page [73405361-b952-50bd-b70b-925cbc02e4ff].
- **Delivery coverage (POL-051):** Coverage depends on the validation result for the delivery region [2089d7f7-38cf-543d-a665-a95ed63dc65a].
- **Shipping & timing (POL-061):** In-stock orders are generally arranged for dispatch within two business days after payment; holidays excluded [e75961c0-1b48-5b71-8cb0-95e3dca2ba5c].
- **Address & redirection (POL-071):** The delivery address can be changed on the checkout page before payment [5d8b66fa-9981-588f-b715-f2d8e65d0b8d].
- **Receipt & inspection (POL-081):** Check before signing for damage, water damage, or obvious crushing of the outer packaging [0d5ccc5e-3dee-5108-8217-367e5399049c].
- **Order cancellation (POL-091):** Unpaid orders can be cancelled from the platform order page [99c34f3a-a08f-5361-96c1-0f10a50ff305].
- **No-reason returns (POL-101):** Eligible items must be requested within seven days after signing [ca960345-43a1-5d76-9467-377cfcb0dfdb].
- **Quality after-sales (POL-111):** For functional faults, first check the usage environment and manual requirements [eecd8beb-ef8e-56df-b720-ba770b988478].
- **Return logistics (POL-121):** Confirm the return address via the after-sales order before sending items back [6d6020a0-2aac-591b-b192-6e7af614379a].
- **Refund progress (POL-131):** After a refund request is submitted, eligibility and materials are reviewed first [53bb0b52-6a74-5039-9d4c-34236e6afd2a].
- **Exchange & repair (POL-141):** Exchanges require verifying stock and the original item's fault first [4ae2153c-26ee-5a2e-8144-f96a0226fe3d].
- **Invoices & vouchers (POL-151):** The invoice title should be filled in accurately when applying [acb5532a-8b8a-5b6f-baee-8d66b0f1fbe2].
- **Privacy & data (POL-161):** Only necessary information for completing orders and after-sales is collected [d1a37dc7-68ce-5197-a624-9bcb86ba82d5].
- **Product descriptions & compatibility (POL-171):** Item numbers distinguish models; similar appearance does not mean identical specs [8c4e2a64-25d5-5238-beb4-78b50fb980cb].
- **Reviews & content (POL-181):** Reviews should be based on actual transaction experience and must not disclose others' privacy [d482564f-51d7-5750-ab09-010a4e026329].
- **Customer service & disputes (POL-191):** Provide an order number for order queries; the system only returns records you can access [4aba55d7-4a53-598c-a243-6d8bf66e3303].

This is a category overview with one example per category, not the complete rule set; full rules are available in the platform documentation by category.

# POL-195 争议材料应包括订单、问题描述和相关凭证

> 虚构平台的模拟政策，用于客服检索测试，不代表现实商家或法律规定。

## 适用范围
本条属于“客服与争议”分类，适用于本模拟平台的零售交易与客服解释。

## 具体规定
争议材料应包括订单、问题描述和相关凭证。

## 处理与核实
涉及具体订单时，先核对本人订单、商品身份与当前业务记录；解释规则不等于已经完成办理。用户应保留与本条事项直接相关的页面、物流或支付凭证，避免提交无关个人信息。

## 例外与边界
如商品详情存在经明确展示的专门条款，应同时核实其适用条件；资料缺失或冲突时说明待核实内容，不自行承诺。现有本地执行工具的资格判断与按钮确认仍独立生效。

sources.title: 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！
sources.content:
今天是2026年11月20日 星期五 农历 十月十二

午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！

受补充冷空气影响，今天白天大风自西向东逐渐加大，午后大部分地区有3、4级偏北风，阵风6、7级，西部山区局地可达8级以上。

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

强劲的北风吹拂之下，片片云团点缀长空，云与蓝天相映，视野疏朗。不过凛冽北风加持下，风寒效应十分突出，体感寒意远重于实际气温，大家外出要注意添衣保暖，谨防着凉感冒。

双休日正赶上明显冷空气的间歇期，终于没有了风雨（雪）的侵扰，晴好天气稳稳上线。阳光相伴、风力不大，午间非常适合出门散步、晒太阳。需要注意的是，虽然阳光明媚，但气温仍然持续较低，尤其早晚期间，寒意更浓，大家外出及时添衣。

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。

sources.title: 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！
sources.content:
今天是2026年11月20日 星期五 农历 十月十二

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

双休日正赶上明显冷空气的间歇期，终于没有了风雨（雪）的侵扰，晴好天气稳稳上线。阳光相伴、风力不大，午间非常适合出门散步、晒太阳。需要注意的是，虽然阳光明媚，但气温仍然持续较低，尤其早晚期间，寒意更浓，大家外出及时添衣。

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。

# 午后风劲云舒寒意浓 双休日天气新更出炉！（2026-11-20）
...
受补充冷空气影响，今天白天大风自西向东逐渐加大，午后大部分地区有3、4级偏北风，阵风6、7级，西部山区局地可达8级以上。

北京市气象台已于昨日19时45分继续发布大风蓝色预警信号，请注意防范。

早晚出行天气

今天下班：晴；偏北风3级，阵风5级左右；7～4℃。

明天早晨：晴；偏北风1～2级；-1～2℃。

天气预报

11月20日（周五）下午：多云转晴；偏北风3～4级（阵风6～7级）；平原地区最高气温9℃，山区最高气温5～7℃；最小相对湿度20%。

20日夜间：晴；
...
平原地区最低气温-2℃，山区最低气温-9～-4℃；最大相对湿度55%。
...
天气趋势

根据最新的气象资料分析，未来一周大部分时间是晴到多云的天气，没有明显雨雪过程，23日、27日前后受冷空气影响，北风较大，请及时关注临近预报预警信息，提前做好防范措施。

温馨提示

1、大风蓝色预警中，今天下午仍有明显北风，风寒效应显著，外出注意防风防寒，远离广告牌等临时搭建物，谨防高空坠物。

2、 风干物燥，及时补充水分并注意用火用电安全。

3、 目前正处于呼吸道和心脑血管疾病高发期，体弱人群要加强健康防护，外出特别注意保暖，帽子、围巾、手套需配备齐全。
...

**Observation:** At 04:00, Beijing was **−0.4°C**, feels like **−3.5°C**, light northwesterly wind, humidity 44%, **0 mm precipitation**, air quality good. By 11:00 it had risen to **6.7°C**; at 20:00 it was **2.4°C**. [北京-天气预报](https://www.nmc.cn/publish/forecast/ABJ/beijing.html)

**Forecast/conditions for the day:** Cloudy turning clear; afternoon north winds 3–4 level with gusts 6–7, stronger in western mountain areas; plain-area high around **9°C**, nighttime low **−2°C**. A blue wind warning was in effect. The weekend is expected to be clear with no rain or snow, and the coming week mostly clear to cloudy with **no significant rain/snow**. [午后风劲云舒寒意浓](http://bj.weather.com.cn/sygdt/11/4867331.shtml)

### Order 1010

- Status: **shipped, in transit** (from the earlier order lookup).

### Does rain prove the order was delayed by weather?

**No — and there's no rain to point to.** The Beijing sources report **0 mm precipitation** and explicitly say there is **no obvious rain/snow** today or in the coming week; the main weather factor is **strong wind**, not rain. So "rain" cannot be the cause of any delay.

Separately, the sources contain **no information about order 1010's dispatch time, promised delivery date, or current delay status**, so I can't confirm whether it is delayed at all, let alone attribute a delay to weather. Weather alone wouldn't establish causation anyway — that would require the order's logistics records showing a specific delay reason.
